Name: Simple Penny Expanded
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
Update and Content Patcher conversion for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1372]Penny Expanded[/url] by Wolvenlight that cleans up bugs and typoes, and deletes about half of the events, while keeping all of the new dialogue. Fixes the order and other requirements, for example the 2 heart group saloon event is supposed to only fire on Fridays, but in the old mod, fires on every day EXCEPT Fridays.

+ Thank you to Wolvenlight for granting permission to post this mod! +

[b]Penny Events:[/b]
2 Hearts, 2 Hearts with Sam+Sebastian+Abigail, Saloon on Friday
3 Hearts, Dwarvish Translation Guide earned, Museum
5 Hearts, Saloon on any day but Friday
7 Hearts, 2 heart Saloon event seen + 3 Heart Museum event seen, Museum
9 Hearts, 7 Hearts with Pam, 5 heart Saloon event seen, Bus Stop

[b]Pam Events:[/b]
3 Hearts, Town
[7 Hearts, The Bus Stop one mentioned above]
[Plus she features in Penny's 5-Heart Saloon event despite not requiring Pam Hearts]

[b]Spoilerific spoilers:[/b]

[Spoiler][b]2 Heart Saloon:[/b] Penny is not really one of the gang but is trying. Her friendship with Sam is developed here.
[b]3 Heart Museum:[/b] Penny displays her intelligence and gets a second job in the Museum (on top of being a teacher).
[b]3 Heart (Pam) Town: [/b]Lighthearted scene where you get to know Pam a bit better.
[b]5 Heart Saloon:[/b] Dark scene where Pam is drunk, and Penny finally is brave enough to call her out in front of everyone.
[b]7 Heart Museum:[/b] Penny reconciles with Abigail a bit after not getting along well previously, however the two nerds find some common ground.
[b]9 Heart Bus Stop: [/b]Pam goes overboard and has to be hospitalized. Some feels are had.[/Spoiler]

+
